caption: The mode bit is 1 in user mode and 0 in kernel mode. It drops to 0 at the 5 ms read() trap, returns to 1 at 7 ms, and drops again at the 10 ms timer interrupt.

spec.aria: A two-lane timeline from 0 to 12 ms shows the mode bit at 1 during user mode, 0 from 5 to 7 ms for read(), 1 again until 10 ms, then 0 when the timer interrupt fires.
